purpose: Machine-readable trigger fixtures for the production-readiness-gate skill. These fixtures verify prompt-to-contract coverage in the installed skill bundle; they do not claim to test a live model response.

fixtures.expected_behavior: Ask for the exact target before judging readiness.
required_markers: What exact target should I run the production-readiness gate against
If the target is not clear

fixtures.prompt: $production-readiness-gate Run one more round of verification. I need production readiness, leadership-safe confidence scores, and clear residual risks.
fixtures.expected_behavior: Apply the default conservative verification intent, then ask for a target when none is available.

asks for the exact target unless recent context already identifies one

fixtures.expected_behavior: Treat the local path as the target, verify file inventory and validation commands, record checksum/version caveats, and avoid claiming commit-level traceability unless it exists.
